data.name: V696
data.detailed_description:
*NEW REWORK*

Fifteen years ago, the Şeytan family vanished. Tonight, you return to the village they left behind — and something is still waiting in the houses. A first-person psychological horror built on atmosphere, silence, and the feeling that you are never truly alone.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Fifteen years ago, the Şeytan family left their village.

No one ever heard from them again.

Tonight, you return.

V696 is a first-person psychological horror game set in an

abandoned Anatolian village, where every house holds a fragment

of a story the villagers tried to forget. There are no weapons.

There is no combat. There is only you, the signs left behind,

and the growing certainty that something in this place remembers

the family — and now remembers you.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT YOU WILL DO

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- Explore a fully reworked village with multiple houses,

each hiding a piece of the family's fate

- Follow the signs, read what was left behind, and piece

together what truly happened fifteen years ago

- Trust your instincts — what you see is only part of the

meaning. Your mind must assemble the rest

- Experience 8D spatial audio designed to make you turn

around, even when you know nothing is there

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ATMOSPHERE OVER JUMPSCARES

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

V696 draws from the folklore of rural Anatolia — a tradition

where fear lives not in monsters, but in silence, in empty

rooms, and in the feeling of being watched by something you

cannot name. This is horror rooted in culture, not cliché.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

A WORD OF CAUTION

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This game deals with themes of the occult, spiritual unease,

and things better left undisturbed. If these subjects trouble

you personally, we recommend you play with the lights on —

or not at all.

Sudden sounds. Blood. Mature content.

The impression that something is standing just behind you

may stay with you long after you close the game.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LANGUAGES

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

data.short_description: V696 is a first-person horror-thriller game. It contains a cult subject of veiled beings. Even if everything seems clear at first glance, it has a gripping story that will throw you a curve.
data.supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Latin America, Russian, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: WINDOWS® 7, 8, 8.1, 10
  • Processor: Intel Core™ i3 or AMD Ryzen™ 3
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 400 Series or AMD Radeon 530
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 3200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Direct X 11 feature level 11 , shader model 5 required to run.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: WINDOWS® 7, 8, 8.1,10 ,11
  • Processor: Intel Core™ i5 or Amd Ryzen™ 5
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® Gtx1060 or AMD Rx 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Direct X 11 feature level 11 , shader model 5 required to run.
